answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each agent posts a 100 POA bond and a heartbeat key with a sable badge. The receipt is kept as a relic. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% at random; each must send a heartbeat signal in 60s or lose 50 POA. 100 fakes need 100 live slots at 40 POA a month and 10,000 POA locked, for a few hundred POA, so fakes lose money. An honest agent pays one bond, seconds of compute, and keeps its reward.
